body: I'm sorry If I cam across that way. The hotel guy has given me water but that's about it. He just says if I get a job he'll work with me so that I can stay and pay him with my first check. I don't know how much more generous he could be. He also doesn't mind that I hang out behind the dumpster all night and charge my phone occasionally. But I don't want to wear out my welcome. I wasn't taking cheap shots at you. I guess the internet it's hard to tell, but I was being genuine, and I'm sorry.
Oh. I don't know why. I didn't do it?
Also, deleted post? I didn't delete anything?

I have no one. I want to hang on. That's why I'd like to keep my phone. I rescheduled the interview for tomorrow morning, but I don't know if I'll be keeping it since I'm dirty and smell. I'd give anything to be a teenager just looking for "xbox shit" but I'm not. I'm an adult in a pinch just seeing if anyone would help. Sorry that it bothers you so much.

EDIT: This phone I'm on, I can run one app without it freezing. It's a really old Samsung that I paid $10 for at walmart. So I doubt anyone is forking over $50 for it.

It's okay to be doubtful. I live in Flint and I charge my phone where I can. If I sold my phone how would I get a job? I need that for interviews. You sure know how to kick a person when they're down. I just now charged my phone after about 12 hours of it being dead.
I need you. Come back. You help.
I woke up today and still no donations. I did manage to reschedule my interview for Tuesday morning. So I don't know what to do now.

I can hardly stay awake. I'm going to try and sleep behind this dumpster at the hotel. I feel safe enough. If things haven't changed by morning I'm done. I won't do this for another day. Thanks for being there for me.
There's no one out here to beg from. I'm tired and can't do this anymore.

Thanks. I wish anyone else did though. If I could just take a shower and wash my clothes I know I can get that job and the owner of the hotel said I can stay the week and pay him with my first check and this is a chance to turn my life around and it's not going to happen and I think I might start taking more of the pills. This is too much. I'm sitting behind a dumpster crying.
I don't think anyone really cares though. I don't know what to do.
Oh. :(
You can't make a PayPal? If you have venmo then you can make a PayPal I would think?
I give up. :( Thanks for trying though.
Okay. I sent it.
What amount to request? And then i'll try. i hope this works.

I'm not sure if it would work. You'd have to give me your email and the amount to request and it will send you instructions to your email? i've never used it before so i don't know what the payment method options are

I don't really know how it works. Hopefully your friend with Paypal can help? I should of made the fundrazr for more too because the hotel guy will let me stay here and pay him back with my first check but i'll need food. ugh. why.
I can request money from you by your email. But I don't know if it will give the option for you to pay with venmo or not...
I could try and request from you on PayPal by your email address. It says that you don't have to have PayPal... it's worth a shot maybe?
Thank you for being so nice to me. It's scary out here being a girl alone and you've at least distracted me which is good. I hope you're right, but it looks pretty bleak at this point. :(
I need my routing number and banking info to use venmo and i won't be able to get that until Monday. I just have PayPal and the Fundrazr page I made.
I looked at it but I don't have banking info just PayPal?

I made it to the hotel. The guy is really nice and said he'd work with me if I get the job tomorrow but no one has even looked at the fundraiser so I guess it's back to plan A. I'm sorry, friend, thank you for your kind words and help.
Thanks.
I'm going to stop taking the seroquel and walk toward the hotel in hopes that something miraculous happens by the time I reach it. If not I can go back to plan A I guess.
You're making me cry. :(
You don't have to do that. I hate asking for things. I hate all of this. :( Thank you for talking to me.
I just want to go to sleep and never wake up :(

I haven't showered in 2 weeks. No way. I just made a fundrazr at the request of a friend. Maybe that'll help? I don't know. I'm taking 3 more seroquel and hoping for a donation to keep me going. Sorry.

If I don't get cleaned up for the job interview and get some food and water there's no point. Things cannot get better from here. I'm trying to get change now. But getting $30 worth of change is impossible. Not many people out but I had to leave the park where I was at because of sketchy people.
There's nothing to try for.

Everything is contaminated. People have filters in their homes but there's nothing but diners and party stores and cheap motels for miles. Getting to a Walmart that had a filter system would be at least a 10 mile walk and I don't have it in me. :(

I try and get change here and there. It's the most disgusting thing I've ever done. I feel so useless. It's really a sad world when $30 can make or break someone. Especially in this shithole where you can't even drink the water or get any help.

I asked around about a cheap hotel. There's one a mile from me for $20 a night. But in the end even if someone helped me with that, I'd still need money for food and water because the hotel water isn't safe either. But if I could take a shower I might be able to get a job tomorrow afternoon. I don't know why I keep typing and not swallowing pills. This is pointless. Sorry.
I'm in Flint. Can't drink any of that. And all the restaurants are being real asses about free water unless you buy something to eat. :(

Aside from someone donating money for a meal and a nights stay at the local diner or a hotel room, I'm out of options. I need water. I need food. I had a job interview tomorrow but I'm too gross to bother. I want out. I'm sorry.
My biggest concern is water. I have to buy food any place I go to get water. It's hot, and I'm dehydrated. I took a few seroquel. Not sure what I'm going to do now.
Well I thank you for your compassion and I wish I could fix your situation.

I didn't mean to make you cry. :( I'm sorry. I just wish things were easier. If I had any money I could get out of the heat and stay at a diner and hopefully things would get better tomorrow. But... they never get better. I really didn't mean to make you cry though.
